description: Delete a file from a GitLab project's repository by creating a commit on the specified branch. You can supply author details and a last known commit ID to detect concurrent modifications, or specify a starting branch when creating the target branch.

author_email.description: The commit author's email address. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.
author_email.title: Author Email

author_name.description: The commit author's name. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.
author_name.title: Author Name

branch.description: Name of the branch where the file will be deleted.
branch.title: Branch

commit_message.description: Commit message describing the file deletion.
commit_message.title: Commit Message

file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file to delete (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/readme.md').
file_path.title: File Path

last_commit_id.description: Last known commit ID for the file. Used to detect concurrent modifications. If provided and the file has been modified since this commit, the deletion will fail.
last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_branch.description: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Used when the target branch doesn't exist yet.
start_branch.title: Start Branch

name: delete_repository_file

branch.description: The branch where the file was deleted.
branch.title: Branch

file_path.description: The path of the deleted file.
file_path.title: File Path

message.description: A message indicating the status of the deletion.
message.title: Message
